title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: use-after-return in coap_oscore_auth_mutating (stack pointer dangles)
description:
P0 correctness bug. coap_oscore_auth_mutating at coap_oscore.c:249 allocates uint8_t plain[CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_PLAINTEXT_MAX] on its own stack, stores result->payload = plain at line 283. After return, plain is reclaimed. Callers (deaddrop_post, msg_inbox_post) dereference auth.payload after return — UB.

Fix: Move plain buffer into struct coap_oscore_auth_result as inline array, or pass buffer from caller.

Affected: coap_oscore.c:249,283 | coap_oscore.h:124-130 | coap_dtn.c:123,152,172 | coap_server.c:341,345
notes: Fix implemented in working tree: deleted orphaned coap_oscore_auth_mutating() (coap_oscore.c) - zero callers repo-wide, struct type removed in 6mij.2.4 refactor, sizeof(*result) on incomplete type made TU uncompilable. Behavior replicated at handlers via coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request + inline local-admin guards. native_sim build verification deferred (EC2 paused by user); deletion-only change, zero references verified by grep.
close_reason: Fix VERIFIED in committed + working-tree state. (1) The dangling-pointer helper is gone: commit 0de6a9383a 'fix(oscore): drop orphaned auth_mutating helper' removed coap_oscore_auth_mutating(); repo-wide rg for coap_oscore_auth_mutating|coap_oscore_auth_result (excluding .beads and docs) returns zero matches (rg exit 1); coap_oscore.h declares only existing functions. (2) The replacement result path is structurally immune to this UAR class: coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request() stores plaintext in result->plainbuf[] EMBEDDED in struct coap_oscore_unprotect_result (coap_oscore.h:52), so result->payload points either into the caller-owned struct or into the caller-owned request packet - never at helper stack memory. (3) deaddrop_post and confessions_post now consume requests through exactly that helper (coap_dtn.c:107-121, 226-241), eliminating the last inline unprotect logic in the file; the keys put/delete inline pattern keeps plain[] handler-local so no pointer escapes its frame. (4) cppcheck (warning,style,performance,portability) passes on coap_dtn.c. Remaining gap: no in-repo build compiles coap_dtn.c (CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP enabled nowhere), so the deferred native_sim compile verification stays deferred - now tracked as project-LICHEN-worker6-qj3l instead of silent debt.
